title: Story premise EDU102: The Contact Plan Has an Offline Copy
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (public safety/preparedness). Hook: What if the plan is inside the phone that will not turn on? Takeaway/theme: A preparedness plan should account for loss of its usual communication tools.
description: A household wants to reconnect during a disruption, but its fictional contact plan exists only on an unavailable device. A reviewed preparedness example adds an accessible offline copy and a mutually agreed contact procedure.
